title: C2 Blockchain, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-17
summary: C2 Blockchain, Inc., a small Nevada corporation, disclosed the rescission and cancellation of 245,000,000 shares of common stock previously issued to Mendel Holdings LLC. The shares were voluntarily returned to the company for cancellation without consideration; Mendel Holdings is controlled by Levi Jacobson, the company's CEO, President, Director, and controlling shareholder.
key_points: C2 Blockchain, Inc. cancelled 245,000,000 shares of common stock previously issued to Mendel Holdings LLC.
Mendel Holdings LLC, owned and controlled by Levi Jacobson, agreed in writing to voluntarily return the shares.
Levi Jacobson is the company's sole officer and director, and controlling shareholder.
The cancelled shares have been returned to the status of authorized but unissued shares.
No consideration was paid by the company in connection with the cancellation.
The filing was signed by Levi Jacobson as CEO, President, and Director on April 17, 2026.

It has no relevance to macro market conditions, financial system stability, or broader market structure. The cancellation reduces the company's outstanding shares, which may affect per-share metrics for existing shareholders.
